title: Register with the portable long service scheme (cleaning, security)
what: Register with the state's portable long service scheme and report eligible workers' service.

sources.title: Portable long service benefits scheme employer registration
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will need this registration if you intend to register your community service, contract cleaning or security business to provide workers with coverage under the Portable Long Service Benefits Scheme.

assessment.summary: Employers must register with the industry's portable long service leave scheme, report workers' service and pay a levy.

marks.reason: Workers keep their long service entitlement when they move between employers in the industry.
Registration, quarterly service returns and the levy.
